name: Jewish Community Alliance of Southern Maine — Mah Jongg
description: JCA offers 6-week beginner Mah Jongg courses taught by Judi Slotsky and weekly open play. Evidence from the JCA page: "Participants must buy their own card from the National Mah Jongg League before the course begins."
schedule: Beginner course: 6 weekly 2-hour sessions ($48 members / $60 non-members per course). Open play Fridays 9:30 AM-12:00 PM ($5 public; free for members). Dates for the next course not confirmed.
